up: Retrieve activity data for the human single-protein target CHEMBL4619 (Dual specificity calcium/calmodulin-dependent 3',5'-cyclic nucleotide phosphodiesterase 1C). Filter for exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values and standard type IC50. Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID, limiting to the first 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id AS tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", a.standard_type AS "standard type", a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4619' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
